newsitem.title: USA: TransAmerican Refining raises offer on notes.
newsitem.headline: TransAmerican Refining raises offer on notes.

text.p: TransAmerican Refining Corp said it is amending to 112 percent the price of its offer to purchase all of its outstanding $340 million of Guaranteed First Mortgage Discount Notes due 2002 and $100 million of Guaranteed First Mortgage Notes due 2002.

Also on Friday, TransAmerican Energy Corp, the parent company of TransAmerican Refining, said it is increasing the price of its offer for all the outstanding warrants to buy common stock in its TransAmerican Refining Corp unit to $4.50 per warrant.
TransAmerican Energy Corp currently owns 80 percent of the common stock of TransTexas Gas Corp and 100 percent of common equity of TransAmerican Refining Corp.
